metadata.article_title: Payment of cheque crossed specially more than once.

article.title: Payment of cheque crossed specially more than once.
article.content:
127Payment of cheque crossed specially more than once.

Section 127  ·  Chapter XIV  ·  page 26 of the Act
Where a cheque is crossed specially to more than one banker, except when crossed to an agent for the purpose of collection, the banker on whom it is drawn shall refuse payment thereof.
